Redone per corrected requirements: replaced the crop-based fit mechanism (cover_v/cover_h) with a valign/halign anchor mechanism. fit_into_tile() keeps its original full-contain scaling (aspect ratio always preserved, content never cropped) and only changes where letterbox/pillarbox padding is placed -- pushed to the outer edge of a tile stack instead of centered, so adjacent tiles' video content touches with no gap. layouts.py assigns bottom/top (featured) or right/left (top_featured) anchors to the first/last tile in a stack; interior tiles (3+ side tiles) stay centered, a documented limitation since interior tiles touch neighbors on both sides and can't have zero padding on both without cropping.

1) Canvas sizing replaced vh-clamp with fitCanvasSize() JS helper fitting 16:9 into the actual measured flex-space (canvasContainerRef is now a plain flex:1,minWidth:0,minHeight:0 centered box, no CSS aspectRatio/maxHeight). 2) 3-column desktop layout: properties (w:220) | canvas (flex:1) | layers (w:190, internal overflowY:auto), in one Group with flex:1,minHeight:0, wrap='wrap' on mobile so columns stack full-width with a 220px minHeight floor on the canvas container. 3) Style name/preview-count moved to SimpleGrid cols={isMobile?1:2} with width:'100%' inputs; switches split into their own row. 4) Properties table now always rendered (moved out of {selected && ...}) with every row present and controls individually disabled (SegmentedControl/NumberInput/Select/Switch disabled={!selected...}), values guarded with selected?.field -- zero layout jump on selection change. onChange handlers guarded with selectedIdx != null. 5) Carousel wrapped in Mantine Collapse with a mobile-only chevron toggle (carouselOpen state), auto-collapses when opening a style on mobile via a useEffect keyed on openStyleId. 1) Properties column overflow fixed: Anchor/Size rows now use Group grow (was fixed w=90 pairs summing to ~290px in a 220px column), Table given tableLayout:'fixed'+width:'100%', label Td trimmed to w=80, column given overflowY:'auto'+minHeight:0 as a vertical safety net. 2&3) useContainerSize rewritten from useRef+effect-on-[ref] (ref identity never changes, so effect only ever fired once) to a callback-ref/state-backed pattern (setNode as the ref prop) -- fixes both the general resize flakiness and the root cause of elements not rendering after opening an empty style then a non-empty one (the observer was never (re)attached to the div once it existed). 4) Mobile canvas sizing switched from a minHeight:220 guess to width:100%+aspectRatio:'16/9' CSS, since flex:1 doesn't drive cross-axis sizing for a wrapped item; desktop keeps the existing fitCanvasSize-into-measured-space approach unchanged.
